author: wittjosiah
principle: When two parallel modules (e.g. `Obj` and `Relation`) expose equivalent operations, keep their signatures structurally aligned -- same function name, same parameter naming, same shape.
fix_shape: Rename the parameter/align the signature with the sibling module's existing convention.

author: wittjosiah
principle: When refactoring a typed API, do not widen its generic constraints, return type, or parameter type to something less precise than what is achievable (e.g. `any`, a broad supertype, or a dropped generic parameter) -- preserve or restore the original precision.
fix_shape: Restore the narrower/generic type signature instead of the widened one.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not hardcode a literal that duplicates a value already derivable from an existing canonical source -- derive it, or explicitly flag the duplication with a TODO if it cannot be fixed now.
fix_shape: Replace the hardcoded literal with a value derived from the canonical source, or add a TODO explaining the debt.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Use the most general applicable accessor for a value's actual (possibly broader) type rather than a narrower kind-specific one that forces a cast.
fix_shape: Swap the kind-specific accessor for the general one that already covers the broader type.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Use the accessor function that guarantees a defined value instead of raw property access that may be undefined, when such an accessor already exists.
fix_shape: Call the guaranteed-non-optional accessor (e.g. `getTypename`/`getVersion`) instead of reading the raw property.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not add a type cast (`as any`, `as X`) to work around a type error -- fix the underlying type or add a runtime assertion so the value is actually verified.
fix_shape: Remove the cast and adjust the type/signature (or add a real runtime assertion) so no cast is needed.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not name a generic type parameter the same as a module/namespace you import (e.g. `Schema`) -- it shadows the import and confuses readers.
fix_shape: Rename the type parameter to a short generic letter (e.g. `T`) constrained appropriately.

author: wittjosiah
principle: When an existing shared utility type/function stops working under a refactor, fix it so call sites can keep using it -- do not inline a bespoke replacement at each call site.
fix_shape: Update the shared utility (e.g. `ExcludeId`) to work with the new shape instead of hand-rolling an equivalent type inline.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Remove a stale TODO/comment once its underlying issue no longer applies.
fix_shape: Delete the TODO comment instead of leaving it once the concern it flagged is resolved.

author: wittjosiah
principle: When adding an entry to an existing lazily-loaded registry/module list, follow the same lazy-loading pattern as the existing entries -- do not eagerly import it.
fix_shape: Wrap the new export in the same lazy-loader factory (e.g. `Capability.lazy`) the sibling entries use.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not add a type cast (`as any`, `as X`) to work around a type error -- fix the underlying type or add a runtime assertion so the value is actually verified.
fix_shape: Remove the cast and adjust the type/signature (or add a real runtime assertion) so no cast is needed.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Order invariant/precondition checks from most fundamental to most derived -- validate the broader condition (existence/shape) before checking a narrower condition that depends on it.
fix_shape: Move the invariant that checks the prerequisite condition before the invariant that checks the derived condition.

author: wittjosiah
principle: When two fields represent overlapping information (a base value and a more complete entity derivable from it), unify to a single field instead of keeping both as separate optional inputs.
fix_shape: Drop the redundant field and derive it from the more complete one where needed.

author: wittjosiah
principle: A mutation-callback API's draft parameter should already carry a mutable type -- do not make callers re-cast it to a mutable type inside the callback.
fix_shape: Type the update/mutate callback's draft parameter as mutable at the source so callers need no cast.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Make an invalid input a compile-time type error instead of a value that merely happens to be wrong -- accept only the specific entity/type the function actually needs.
fix_shape: Narrow the parameter type so passing the wrong kind fails to typecheck, not just at runtime.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Prefer an existing unified query API that already spans multiple sources (e.g. registry + database) over hand-writing separate calls to each source.
fix_shape: Call the existing combined query API with both targets instead of querying each source manually.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not add a second mechanism (a new class, a new storage path, a hand-rolled lookup) to serve a concern an existing mechanism (registry, query API, lock) already serves -- extend or reuse the existing one.
fix_shape: Route the new need through the existing mechanism/API instead of building a parallel one.
